blacklistabilityReview.evidence: Re-reviewed 2026-10-01. Ethereum Savingcoin remains a constructor-deployed ERC-4626/ERC20 without a local blacklist, freeze, pause, seize, or arbitrary-holder-burn entry point. Solana finalized slot 452226658 reports freezeAuthority = null. However, the subsequently catalogued Tempo wsrUSD TIP-20 representation 0x20c000000000000000000000aeed2ec36a54d0e5 has its own local administrative censorship surface: at pinned Tempo block 42066495, paused() was false, transferPolicyId() was 1 (always-allow), and hasRole(0xb7570e32ded63b25163369d5eb4d8e89e70e5602, DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE) was true. The TIP-20 specification directly permits DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE to change transferPolicyId, including always-reject or custom policies. Current permissive state does not remove that power. Thus wsrUSD has possible local holder-transfer restriction on Tempo as well as the existing inherited rUSD exposure; the prior inherited-only conclusion no longer describes every authored deployment.
